rows.en: And that's why the doctor ended up like this?
But, Goro… it's absolutely necessary to make Jiro a complete android.
But… is that what he wants?

That's…

I, I just… find it so painful to watch Jiro suffer.
Ah… ugh…
Doctor, Dr. Araki… the blueprints… Where are the blueprints?
Ugh… the blueprints… the Conscience… Circuit blueprints are… with my daughter… my daughter, Taeko…

Your daughter!?

Your daughter has the blueprints? Where is she?
Ah… Doctor!
Doctor! Doctor!

Doctor… Dr. Araki…

I'll work as hard as I can and become like you and Dr. Komyoji, and someday, someday for sure, I'll complete the Conscience Circuit with my own hands.
Professor Yokoegawa…
Mitsuko… Please let me study as a member of the TDF science group too!!

Of course…

I'm sure… everyone will welcome you.
Emperor Banba… he truly was a demon king out of hell! But I've defeated the Neo-Human Empire!
Fufufufu… Goro Watari! Don't be so impressed by the likes of Emperor Banba.
Who on earth are you?
My name is Udesper!!
Udesper?

Banba was nothing more than a unit commander!

Fuhrer Geisel, who will rule the Neo-Humans from now on, possesses power far surpassing Emperor Banba's!
Fuhrer Geisel, you say!?
The leader of us, the "Desper Army"!
The Desper Army?
Goro Watari! Behold! The figure of Fuhrer Geisel!
What!?
Kuh… The Desper Army… Fuhrer Geisel? A truly terrifying army.
Goro Watari! I can't let you leave like this! Our army defeats every enemy! Here I come!
Nuoh!?
Kuh… He got away!?
Wait!
Goro Watari, third-year student at Tonan University…
How do you know about me? Who on earth are you?

You want to know?

…Do you recognize this?
That's…!? That badge… Interpol?

Makoto Arai, Interpol secret agent… I'm investigating the movements of the Neo-Humans.

Though on the surface, I'm an executive of the Anti-Shocker League…

I know everything about you. Fuhrer Geisel's Desper Army is even more cold-blooded and ruthless than the Phantom Army. Let's cooperate with each other.

Starting today, you'll live in my secret hideout.

To get at you, they'll launch indiscriminate attacks without a second thought. They think of human lives as no better than bugs.

If you keep living in the city, the people around you will be killed too.

My secret hideout is 50 meters underground. And it's a maze, so absolutely nobody can get in.
I can't drag any more innocent people into this! …I'll take you up on it!

What!?

Bara Banbara killed Dr. Araki before getting the blueprints?
Yes…

Fool! What a disgrace!

Nngh… that useless Phantom Army! Summon Banba! Summon Emperor Banba!

Sir…

About that… Emperor Banba was defeated by Goro Watari… The Phantom Army has been wiped out.

What!? Emperor Banba?

Well, no matter… We may have joined hands for a time, but I never counted on him!

Kaimen Green! So… where are the blueprints?

We believe Komyoji's daughter, Mitsuko, has learned where the Conscience Circuit blueprints are…

If we keep watch on Mitsuko and the others, we'll surely…

Good! Whatever happens, don't let Kikaider get there first!

If he gets his hands on it and his Conscience Circuit is made complete, the ultrasonic flute will lose its effect!

Understood!? Leave no stone unturned and seize Araki's blueprints!
What attacked Goro Watari, fresh from his death match with Emperor Banba, was the Desper Army, mightier still than Banba's Phantom Army.
And Fuhrer Geisel, who leads that army of terror, is…
To avoid the Desper Army's indiscriminate attacks, Goro Watari moved out of his university dorm and into the secret base of the secret agent Makoto Arai.
Now, a new battle is about to begin.
Doctor, Dr. Araki! Are you all right? Are you hurt?
No… I'm fine. Thank you so much… They very nearly stole the blueprints.
The blueprints Taeko mentioned?
Yes… The blueprints for the android Conscience Circuit I completed.

A Conscience Circuit?

I see… So that's what the Neo-Humans were after?
It's too dangerous for me to keep them, after all…
But… that's weird. Why would the Neo-Humans need a Conscience Circuit?
But… that's strange. Why would the Neo-Humans need a Conscience Circuit?
Hmm… That is strange.

…!?

There it is again…
What's wrong, Goro?
What's wrong, Goro?
Just as I thought… the sound of this pendant is calling me.
Hm… what's that!? Somebody's collapsed over there!
Ugh… ugh…

It's a woman…

What happened? Hang in there!
Wh-where am I?

………

Um… I'm probably wrong, but… is your name Watari…?
Watari? Don't tell me you're… from 15 years ago?
That's right, 15 years ago! You're Shinobu!? Then…
Goro, it's you, Goro? It is, isn't it?
Mom…
Gorooo!!
Mom, Mom!!
I was sure you'd died 15 years ago, Mom…
I'm sorry, Goro. I searched everywhere for you too, but…
Anyway, let's go to my dorm. There's so much I want to talk about…
About that, Goro… I can't go there. Won't you come with me instead?
Where? Where should I go?

uncertain: U04047: [ja] rendered 'Interpol secret agent' per glossary.
U04049: お願いします read as Goro accepting Arai's offer ('I'll take you up on it').
U04070: narration-continuation row; Goro reacting to the pendant's sound again.
U04082: そうだよ、15年前にシノブって！？ is garbled; read as Goro recognizing the name Shinobu.
